sn12.18:1.2: atha kho timbaruko paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn12.18:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho timbaruko paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.18:2.1: kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhanti?
sn12.18:2.5: kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkhanti?
sn12.18:2.7: kimpana bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhanti?
sn12.18:2.9: kinnu kho bho gotama, natthi sukhadukkhanti?
sn12.18:2.12: tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti, na passati?
sn12.18:2.13: nakhvāhaṃ timbaruka, sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
sn12.18:3.1: kinnu kho bho gotama, “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkhanti” iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ timbarukāti vadesi.
sn12.18:3.2: “kimpana bho gotama, paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkhanti” iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ timbarukāti vadesi.
sn12.18:3.3: “kinnu kho bho gotama, sayaṃkatañca paraṃkatañca sukhadukkhanti” iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ timbarukāti vadesi.
sn12.18:3.4: “kimpana bho gotama, asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ sukhadukkhanti” iti puṭṭho samāno mā hevaṃ timbarukāti vadesi.
sn12.18:3.5: “kinnu kho bho gotama, natthi sukhadukkhanti” iti puṭṭho samāno na kho timbaruka, natthi sukhadukkhaṃ,
sn12.18:3.7: “tena hi bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāti na passatīti” iti puṭṭho samāno ‘na khvāhaṃ timbaruka, sukhadukkhaṃ na jānāmi, na passāmi.
sn12.18:3.10: ācikkhatu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn12.18:3.11: desetu ca me bhavaṃ gotamo sukhadukkhanti.
sn12.18:4.1: “sā vedanā, so vediyatī”ti kho timbaruka, ādito sato “sayaṃkataṃ sukhadukkha”nti evampahaṃ na vadāmi.
sn12.18:4.2: aññā vedanā “añño vediyatī”ti kho timbaruka, vedanābhitunnassa sato “paraṃkataṃ sukhadukkha”nti, evampahaṃ na vadāmi.
sn12.18:4.3: ete te timbaruka, ubho ante anupagamma majjhena tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti:
sn12.18:5.1: evaṃ vutte timbaruko paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn12.18:5.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn12.18:5.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
